text: Teaching ObjectivesTo produce graduates with good business management skills that are efficient in Asia as well as in the rest of the world. The programs concentrate on personal development and the acquisition of business skills to: ensure that each student is challenged individually to attain the highest standards of personal excellence; introduce students to some basic humanities and social science courses that help them expand their perspective, and become responsible members of civil society; ensure that students learn to question assumptions and come up with creative and meaningful solutions; enhance learning by hands-on projects and teamwork.Main courses Foundation of Economics and Trading Theory; Corporate Strategy; Business Accounting; Programming Design Lab; International Marketing; Supply Chain Management; Microeconomics; Cognition Practice; Probability and Statistics; Applied Statistics; MacroeconomicsFor more curriculum details, please click here InternshipStudents will have the opportunities to be engaged in industrial collaborative projects, interview techniques, resume instructions and review, visits to companies, and career consultation.Degree AwardedBachelor Degree of Business Administration (BBA).Future CareerThe graduates can work in the International trade transportation, insurance, customs clearance etc agencies, specialized foreign-trade corporations, and import and export department's of foreign-owned enterprises.
